active.title: context dead --snapshot pauses open worktrees: archive/wt tag for a private repo, local bundle for a public one
active.description:
Measured (HEAD e83e55783): `dead` refuses while any `wt/*` worktree of the context is open (`_dead_preflight`, `features/spec_context/service.py:679-692`, from `worktree_rows` and `GitSubprocessClient.unrecoverable`, `infrastructure/git_subprocess.py:244-266`; ADR 0128 layer 4), so work in flight cannot be paused; the exits are merge or clean only (ADRs 0099, 0128 layer 1); `alive` (`service.py:462-529`) knows nothing of worktrees. The pre-push already scans tags and skips branch policy for them (`features/chokepoints/push_gate.py:176-189`). Change: path 1 = merge (exists); path 2 = `context dead --snapshot`: an identity preflight (`GitSubprocessClient.identity_fix`) refuses before anything is touched -> per open `wt/*` a WIP commit on its branch that stages only that worktree (untracked included, ignored never; never `repos/<r>`) -> the same denylist+baseline scan the pre-push runs -> visibility by `gh repo view --json visibility` (unknown = public): private -> tag `archive/wt/<ctx>/<repo>/<name>` pushed to origin (never a branch, ADR 0120); public or unknown -> `git bundle` at `.dadaia/snapshots/<ctx>/<repo>/<name>.bundle` with a 'not portable' warning, in a new durable zone `.dadaia/snapshots/` (no TTL; a bundle leaves only when `alive` restores it or by an explicit verb; `export --hard` packs it from there; `.dadaia/reaped/` and the reaper gain no special case; ADR 0112, nothing is deleted by time) -> the worktree is removed. `alive` lists the context's snapshots and prints the restore `fix:` in the new layout. For `wt/*` trees the snapshot replaces the preflight's per-worktree refusal lines; a foreign worktree keeps its refusal. ADD justified: no unit carries pausing; it reuses the archive tag (ADR 0120), the push scan and `identity_fix`; its only new surface is the `snapshots` zone. Done when: dead with an open worktree in a public and in a private repo finishes losing no byte (the tag or the bundle restores the tree, untracked files included), and nothing of a public repo leaves the machine. Files: features/spec_context/service.py (dead, alive), infrastructure/git_subprocess.py (unrecoverable), features/chokepoints (scan, reused), dd-gitflow-default/scripts/_worktree_end.py, cli/commands/context.py, core/workspace_layout.py (the new `snapshots` zone in `DADAIA_ZONES`), public/data/dadaia-AGENTS.md (the zone row of `.dadaia/AGENTS.md`). Import (`features/import_/service.py:59-74`) raises `KeyError` on a record without name/slug/repo_url, uncaught by the CLI (`cli/commands/import_.py:34` catches DadaiaError/ValueError), and turns `repo_url: null` into the string 'None'. Scope narrowed by SPEC 0.4.6 D12/D15 (tar retired, f4bf7e0b2); no ADR covers export. Change: export is read-only (delete `_refresh_branches` and its `_store.update`); soft (default) `.dadaia/dist/spec-contexts.json` schema v2: contexts (slug, name, state, main repo url, associated [{slug,url}]), the exact `dadaia_version`, the harnesses of `.dadaia/states/harness_profile.json`, per repo its snapshots (tags portable; bundles listed as not portable, warning exit); hard `dadaia export --hard` -> one `.tar.gz` in `.dadaia/dist/` = soft + bundles of every open worktree and every bundle of `.dadaia/snapshots/`, content passed through the denylist+baseline scan (a hit refuses); never the denylist, credentials, sessions or the install ledger. The `dist` zone (`core/workspace_layout.py:194`) admits both. The artifact reader is hardened: an incomplete record -> DadaiaError, a null url refused. ADD justified: the hard artifact is the one carrier of local-only work (a public repo's bundle never leaves by git). It does not resurrect the retired tar pipeline's bug class (import-extracts-manifest-to-root): one archive of fixed members (the soft JSON and `snapshots/<ctx>/<repo>/<name>.bundle`); every member validated before extraction (no absolute path, no `..`, no link, nothing outside that list); the JSON is read in memory and extraction is confined to `.dadaia/snapshots/`, never the root.
